business_overview.one_sentence: The group sells luxury goods through retail/wholesale, concession and consignment channels, and also runs a securities investment segment.
business_overview.revenue_model: Luxury goods sales and concession/consignment net income; securities investment revenue includes fair value change, dividends, and interest from debt securities and short-term bank deposits.
business_notes: Retail network totaled 63 stores: 5 Hong Kong, 32 China and 26 Taiwan.
Sales mix disclosed by management: watches and jewellery 49.9%, cosmetics and beauty 18.0%, fashion and accessories 26.1%, securities trading 6.0%.
Hong Kong sales decreased 29.0% amid weak local/tourist shopping demand.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Treasury/debt-security interest, not retail operating profit.
Investment segment income from fair value changes and interest/dividends.
Non-cash impairments on PPE and right-of-use assets tied to weak stores.

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash and bank balances, majority short-term deposits with international banks; geography/currency not fully split.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Consolidated CFO is distorted by securities trading flows. After excluding securities trading cash movement, deducting PPE capex and lease principal gives a 3-year lease-adjusted FCF range of roughly HK$72m-HK$136m; FY2025 retail profit dropped sharply, so owner-earnback denominator uses HK$120m pre-haircut and 0.70 cash-profit haircut.

gaps: Cash and bank balances are not split by listed parent, offshore entities, Hong Kong/Taiwan/Mainland subsidiaries, or restricted status beyond the cash-equivalent definition.
Other financial assets note does not provide issuer-level liquidity, maturity schedule, fair value hierarchy details in the extracted fact pack, or tax cost on liquidation.
Maintenance versus growth capex is not explicitly disclosed; PPE purchase cash is used as a conservative maintenance proxy for retail store operations.
Market capitalization comes from rough_screen_row rather than a newly verified quote; currency is HKD per input.
